name: evolve_modular_substrate
description: Run modular HyperNEAT-LEO evolution on the Turing GPU (or CPU fallback). Returns fingerprint-locked modular J matrix, modular fitness, sparsity, and thermo stats. Use when modular differentiation of the energy landscape or agent topology is required.

n_nodes.description: Number of nodes in the substrate (default 16)

hermitian_sym.description: Force approximate Hermitian symmetry on the weight matrix for self-adjoint energy/attention operators

name: run_gibbs
description: Run Metropolis or simple annealing on the current (or provided) EnergyLandscape. Returns final energy, config, accept rate, Landauer proxy, and wall time.

n.description: Landscape size if creating a fresh toy landscape (default 24)

use_modular_J.description: If true and a modular result is available, use its J matrix

name: get_spectral_gap
description: Estimate spectral-gap proxy of the current EnergyLandscape for adaptive beta / adiabaticity decisions.

name: dispatch_job
description: Dispatch a sampling or evolution job onto the dual-node control plane.

name: collect_results
description: Collect completed job results from the dual-node results directory.

name: get_landscape_fingerprint
description: Return the current EnergyLandscape content fingerprint and basic stats.
